sampling_contract.g_current: current actor pre-tanh Gaussian transformed by its normal tanh
sampling_contract.g_mix: slot 0 current; odd slots tanh(exact prior); even slots current
sampling_contract.g_prior_exact: unbounded standard Gaussian exactly mapped by DSRL policy.scale_action
sampling_contract.primary_view: shared current-policy slot-0 anchor plus K-1 named-family candidates
sampling_contract.tanh_saturation_accounting: only coordinates produced by a tanh transform; exact-prior coordinates are tracked by boundary/out-of-envelope metrics instead
